body:
## Summary
- Adds `grid.html` that takes best practices from `blueprint.html` to create an interactive grid of self-referencing links
- Single slider controls number of links (1–64); links auto-arrange in a square grid (`ceil(sqrt(n))` x `ceil(sqrt(n))`)
- Default is 4 links (2x2 grid) with one grid unit gap between links
- Each link has a unique evenly-spaced HSL color across the RGB spectrum
- Visible control points for each link: start (link color + green 0.5 opacity), center (link color), end (link color + red 0.5 opacity) — matching blueprint.html style
- Per-link colored cross/arrow markers
- Includes infinite background grid, zoom/pan (mouse + touch), localStorage persistence, and Reset button (full-width)
- Reuses existing modules: `ik-pure.mjs`, `constants.mjs`, `geometry.mjs`

## Screenshot (2x2 grid, 4 links — default)

![grid-2x2](https://github.com/konard/links-visuals/blob/issue-23-f9a59e86396c/docs/screenshots/grid-2x2.png?raw=true)

## Test plan
- [x] All existing unit tests pass (48/48)
- [ ] Open `grid.html` in browser and verify:
  - Slider changes link count from 1 to 64
  - Default is 4 links (2x2 grid)
  - Links have evenly spaced colors across RGB range
  - One grid unit gap between links vertically and horizontally
  - Control points visible: start (green overlay), center (link color), end (red overlay)
  - Each link shows self-referencing figure-eight shape with colored cross/arrow markers
  - Zoom (scroll wheel) and pan (mouse drag) work
  - Touch zoom/pan works on mobile
  - Link count persists across page reload via localStorage
  - Reset button clears localStorage and restores defaults (4 links)

Fixes #23

Issue: https://github.com/konard/links-visuals/issues/23

Creates grid.html that takes best practices from blueprint.html:
- Slider to configure number of links (1-64)
- Links arranged in square grid (ceil(sqrt(n)) x ceil(sqrt(n)))
- Each link rendered as self-referencing (start=end=center, figure-eight)
- Infinite background grid with zoom/pan (mouse + touch)
- LocalStorage persistence for link count
- Reset button (100% width) to restore defaults
- Same markers, path rendering, and IK solver as blueprint

Fixes #23
